item.title: Keeping Secrets Out of .mcp.json: A Credential Manager Wrapper Pattern for Windows
item.description: Why environment-variable substitution doesn’t work for MCP server configs on Windows, and how a small PowerShell wrapper backed by Windows Credential Manager solves it for both stdio and HTTP servers.
